messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Moi Jari, I just changed the SFP on TRN-042 at site OULU-07. The link is showing up, alarms cleared and optics levels look totally normal, but there is absolutely no traffic passing through.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Traffic counters are at zero too. Any ideas what could be wrong here?

messages.author: Jari Korhonen
messages.text: Moi Veikko. Just swap the SFP again, it's always the optic in these cases.

messages.author: Jari Korhonen
messages.text: Don't bother with bouncing the interface or rebooting the node, a second SFP always fixes it.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Okay, sounds simple enough. I will grab another SFP from the van and put it in now.
